clue.text: Return to the original winding track

definitions.meaning: to revert to the earlier setting, as when you flick a device back
a zigzag mountain road or a roller-coaster ride

explanation.surface: Someone heads back along the twisting path they first came by.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a phrasal verb meaning revert, and a noun for a zigzagging road or railway.

clue.text: Wrestling with a bit of maths? Nothing to it!

parts.note: a sum is a piece of arithmetic
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Is grappling as easy as basic arithmetic?
explanation.definitionFit: Sumo is a Japanese style of wrestling between heavy contestants.

clue.text: Calm saint ignored something like a cold?

indicators.note: ignored means the saint is passed over and taken out of the word

parts.note: stillness is calm, quiet

explanation.surface: A peaceful holy man ignored a sniffle.
explanation.definitionFit: A cold is a minor sickness, so an example of the broader category of ailment.

clue.text: Hollow lure with gold should have included a warning to shopper

indicators.note: should have included means the outer pieces must take the next letter into their midst

parts.note: a cave is a hollow in rock
to tempt is to lure
OR is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: An empty enticement with gilt ought to have carried a consumer alert.
explanation.walkthrough: A goes between CAVE and TEMPT. The answer is Latin for 'let the buyer beware'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin maxim tells a buyer that the risk of a purchase falls on them.

clue.text: Audacity of bishop coming with age

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
oldness is age, being advanced in years

explanation.surface: A churchman grows bolder as he gets older.
explanation.definitionFit: Boldness and audacity are synonyms for daring nerve.

clue.text: Money about to be provided for shopping complex?

parts.note: a cent is a coin, a unit of money
RE means about or concerning

explanation.surface: Cash on hand for a retail development.
explanation.definitionFit: A centre can be a shopping precinct, a mall where stores cluster.

clue.text: Friend with minimal marks gets the prize

parts.note: pal is an informal word for a friend

indicators.note: minimal means only the smallest part of the word marks is used, its opening letter

explanation.surface: A mate with poor exam scores somehow still collects an award.
explanation.definitionFit: A palm is a traditional emblem of victory, so it stands for a reward or honour.

clue.text: A man going round pub upset someone from middle east

indicators.note: going round means the outer pieces encircle another

parts.note: Ian is a man's name

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means the word for a pub is turned upside down, read backwards

parts.note: a bar is a pub

explanation.surface: A man circles an overturned pub belonging to someone from the region.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns BAR into RAB, which A and IAN surround.
explanation.definitionFit: An Arabian is a native of Arabia, a person from that region.

clue.text: Composer to drive men potty

indicators.note: potty means crazy, so the letters of to drive men go mad

explanation.surface: A musician says he will make the men go crazy.
explanation.definitionFit: Claudio Monteverdi was an Italian composer of early opera.

clue.text: Spiteful man not heartless when cuddling animal

indicators.note: cuddling means the outer pieces wrap their arms around another piece

parts.note: male is a synonym of man

indicators.note: heartless asks for the central letter of the word not to be removed

parts.note: a vole is a small rodent

explanation.surface: A nasty fellow nonetheless hugs a creature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartless' takes O from NOT, leaving NT; 'cuddling' puts VOLE between MALE and NT.
explanation.definitionFit: Malevolent is a synonym meaning wishing harm on others.

clue.text: Fellow entertaining institute's principal

indicators.note: entertaining means playing host to, so one piece holds another inside

parts.note: man is a synonym of fellow
I is the standard abbreviation for institute

explanation.surface: A man plays host to the head of an institute.
explanation.definitionFit: Main and principal are synonyms meaning chief or most important.

clue.text: Collection arranged before the match

parts.note: the match is a marriage: linen and household goods a woman stored up in readiness for setting up home

explanation.surface: Kit is sorted in advance of the fixture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'match' suggests sport but means a wedding.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiomatically, a trousseau stored by someone preparing for marriage.

clue.text: Woman with very little time

parts.note: V is the abbreviation for very, and a single letter is very little of it
an era is a period of time

explanation.surface: A lady who can barely spare a moment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'very little' gives just V, the short form of 'very'; ERA is a span of time.
explanation.definitionFit: Vera is a woman's first name, an example of the category.

clue.text: Something in a drug container disguised

indicators.note: disguised means the letters of the word container are rearranged to conceal it

explanation.surface: A drug smuggled in a camouflaged box.
explanation.definitionFit: Narcotine is an alkaloid found in opium, so it is one component of that drug.

clue.text: Bird now possibly in danger from fox to act cowardly

definitions.text: Bird now possibly in danger from fox
definitions.meaning: a hen let out of its coop and so exposed to a predator

explanation.definitionFit: Literally a fowl outside its coop at risk from a predator; idiomatically, to back away through fear.

clue.text: In a mess: the woman, having taken one drug or another

indicators.note: In places the next pieces inside the word for a mess

parts.note: hash is a muddle, as in making a hash of something

indicators.note: having taken means one piece is followed by what it has swallowed

parts.note: she refers to a woman
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: A woman in trouble after trying first one drug, then a second.
explanation.walkthrough: SHE plus E sits inside HASH, split as HA...SH. E is 'one drug'; the answer is 'another', a variant spelling of hashish.
explanation.definitionFit: The answer is a variant of hashish, a different drug from the ecstasy already named.

clue.text: A batsman of standing? On the contrary!

definitions.text: A batsman of standing? On the contrary!

parts.words: A batsman of standing? On the contrary!
parts.note: reverse the phrase: not a batsman of standing but the standing of a batsman, how a cricketer positions himself at the crease

explanation.surface: Is this a distinguished cricketer? Quite the reverse.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the batsman stands at the crease facing the bowler; the way he plants his feet has a name.
explanation.definitionFit: A stance is the posture someone takes, such as a batter's set position before a delivery.

clue.text: Local support

parts.note: local is a British word for the neighbourhood pub, so this is something that holds up a drinker there

explanation.walkthrough: 'Local' is a Brit's regular pub, not community backing.
explanation.definitionFit: A tall seat at a pub counter, on which a regular sits.

clue.text: Sofa would allow one to have a sleep in church!

indicators.note: in means these pieces go inside the letters for church

parts.note: CE is the abbreviation for the Church of England
A is the indefinite article, meaning one
a nap is a short sleep

explanation.surface: A settee would let a worshipper doze off during the service.
explanation.definitionFit: A canape is a French-style couch or settee, besides being a cocktail snack.

clue.text: Things needing to be changed in the nursery?

definitions.text: Things needing to be changed in the nursery?

parts.words: Things needing to be changed in the nursery?
parts.note: not decor or plans but what a baby wears that gets swapped regularly

explanation.definitionFit: British word for diapers, the absorbent garments infants wear.

clue.text: Country worker giving female member assistance

parts.note: an arm is a limb, a member of the body
a hand is help, as in lend a hand

explanation.surface: A rural labourer helps a woman out.
explanation.definitionFit: A farmhand is a labourer employed on agricultural land.

clue.text: Danger signal with British invading a province

indicators.note: invading means the abbreviation for British forces its way into the warning

parts.note: an alert is a warning signal

explanation.surface: Warning raised as Brits occupy a region.
explanation.definitionFit: Alberta is a province of western Canada.

clue.text: Woman archdeacon upset, in a state

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means the two pieces are read from the bottom up

parts.note: Ada is a woman's name
Ven, short for Venerable, is the title of an archdeacon

explanation.surface: A lady clergyman is in a right state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns ADAVEN into the answer; 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Nevada is one of the United States.

clue.text: Some reply being redrafted by the bosses

indicators.note: redrafted means the letters of some and reply are written out again in a new order

explanation.surface: Management rewrite part of a letter of response.
explanation.definitionFit: Employers are the people who hire staff, synonyms of managers or bosses.

clue.text: Garment not right for bob

annotationWithheld.why: Garment not right for bob (4) as held: no reading of 'not right for bob' leads to ROBE; the clue appears garbled (perhaps 'right for L' in LOBE) and no source gives the original.

clue.text: Man is one I killed almost

indicators.note: almost means the word for killed is not quite completed

parts.note: slew is the past tense of slay, to kill

explanation.surface: A man confesses he nearly committed murder.
explanation.walkthrough: Man is the Isle of Man, between Britain and Ireland; 'almost' drops the last letter of SLEW.
explanation.definitionFit: The island called Man is an example of an island, one in the Irish Sea.

clue.text: Greeting in middle of room somewhere in USA

indicators.note: in means the greeting is placed within the central letters of room
middle of asks for the central letters of the word room

parts.note: hi is an informal greeting

explanation.surface: A hello offered in the centre of a room somewhere in America.
explanation.walkthrough: The middle of ROOM is OO; HI goes between them.
explanation.definitionFit: Ohio is a state of the United States, an example of a place there.

clue.text: Robin's instant meal? Potential problem

definitions.meaning: a robin feeds on worms, so a tin of them would be its ready meal
a situation likely to create trouble once opened up

explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: opening something that unleashes complications; literally, a tin full of earthworms a bird would relish.

clue.text: Try in international game

definitions.meaning: to try something is to put it through a trial
an international cricket or rugby match

explanation.definitionFit: A trial or examination; also a match between national sides in cricket or rugby.

clue.text: Do material specially — if garment's this

indicators.note: specially means the letters of do and material are made into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: Instructions to fashion fabric to order, as a bespoke garment would be.
explanation.definitionFit: Clothing cut to fit one client is bespoke, made by a tailor to measure.
